mapper.select: SELECT O.OVERDUE_ID AS overdueId, O.LOAN_ID AS loanId, O.OVERDUE_START_DATE AS overdueStartDate, O.OVERDUE_DAYS AS overdueDays, O.RELEASE_DATE AS releaseDate, O.SANCTION_STATUS AS sanctionStatus, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.MEMBER_NM AS memberNm, B.TITLE AS bookTitle FROM TB_OVERDUE O JOIN TB_LOAN L ON O.LOAN_ID = L.LOAN_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON L.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID JOIN TB_BOOK B ON L.BOOK_ID = B.BOOK_ID WHERE O.OVERDUE_ID = #{overdueId}

SELECT O.OVERDUE_ID AS overdueId, O.LOAN_ID AS loanId, O.OVERDUE_START_DATE AS overdueStartDate, O.OVERDUE_DAYS AS overdueDays, O.RELEASE_DATE AS releaseDate, O.SANCTION_STATUS AS sanctionStatus, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.MEMBER_NM AS memberNm, B.TITLE AS bookTitle FROM TB_OVERDUE O JOIN TB_LOAN L ON O.LOAN_ID = L.LOAN_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON L.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID JOIN TB_BOOK B ON L.BOOK_ID = B.BOOK_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY O.OVERDUE_START_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_OVERDUE SET OVERDUE_DAYS = #{overdueDays} WHERE OVERDUE_ID = #{overdueId}
mapper.select: SELECT L.LOAN_ID AS loanId, L.BOOK_ID AS bookId, L.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, L.LOAN_DATE AS loanDate, L.DUE_DATE AS dueDate FROM TB_LOAN L LEFT JOIN TB_OVERDUE O ON L.LOAN_ID = O.LOAN_ID WHERE L.LOAN_STATUS = '1' AND L.DUE_DATE < CURDATE() AND O.OVERDUE_ID IS NULL
